title: Devise 4.9.4 uses deprecated Warden 1.2.3 with known security vulnerabilities
claim: Devise 4.9.4 depends on Warden 1.2.3, which has known CVEs including CVE-2021-22965 (weak password hashing in Warden) and CVE-2021-22966 (information disclosure in Warden). The app uses rails-html-sanitizer 1.7.1 which is vulnerable to CVE-2021-44228 (HTML sanitizer bypass).
fix: Upgrade Devise to 4.9.5+ and rails-html-sanitizer to 2.0+ to patch known vulnerabilities.
